column1: # UnitType batch: owner <TAB> kind <TAB> old <TAB> descriptor <TAB> semantic name
# Semantics confirmed from 17_UnitType字段与方法语义映射.md (read from source) + ruleset cross-check.
# Fields already renamed in the 2026-09-18 pilot (name/key/code/health/building/layer/domain/size/
# Fields left obfuscated on purpose (unconfirmed semantics): p (r()), A (E()), B (F()).
#   a/UnitTypeList -> allUnitTypes        : the master list this type belongs to (damage-matrix universe).
#   o/float        -> verticalOffset       : computed vertical draw offset for flying units.
#   q/boolean      -> requiresFacingTarget : must rotate to face target (requiresFacingTarget).
#   u/int          -> salvo                : shots per volley (getSalvo / hasSalvo).
#   w/boolean      -> isGeneral            : the commander unit (only General has it true; +15000 sort).
#   y/boolean      -> capturable           : can itself be captured (isCapturable).
#   C/int          -> rangeInTiles         : attack range expressed in tiles (getRangeInTiles).
#   E/UnitType     -> producer             : the unit type that produces this one (getProducer, computed).
#   F/UnitTypeList -> producedBy           : types that can build this one (getProducedBy).
#   G/UnitTypeList -> canProduce           : types this one can carry/produce (getCanProduce).
#   I/boolean      -> canCarryAircraft     : can hold aircraft (carrier/airfield; canCarryAircraft).
#   g()/static int -> getSlotLimit         : the slot-limit constant 24 (WorldSimulator uses /5).
# NOTE: buildUnit() reads legacy JSON keys positionally, so it is untouched. Only ModLoader.ALIASES
# and ModFieldAliasTest must be updated so fieldName() still resolves the legacy letters.
